C062C.title: Brake Booster Motor B Performance
C062C.description: Brake booster motor B does not deliver expected performance. In an electromechanical booster an electric motor drives a gear stage that pushes on the master cylinder piston; some designs split the motor into two windings or channels, A and B, so that one can keep working if the other fails. If power assist is lost, the brakes still work through the master cylinder, but a much higher pedal force is needed.
symptoms: Brake system warning lamp or message
Firmer brake pedal, longer pedal travel or higher pedal force
Driver-assistance functions such as automatic emergency braking or adaptive cruise control may be disabled
